# Health-check latency

Inline: $\frac{1}{2}$, $\sqrt{n}$ and \(\alpha \leq \beta\).

The response time is:

\text{health-check latency}
=
\text{waiting to run}
+
\text{handler execution}
+
\text{response/network time}

## Multiline equation

$$
\begin{aligned}
T &= T_{\text{wait}} + T_{\text{handler}} \\
  &\quad + T_{\text{network}}
\end{aligned}
$$

- Inline math in a list: $\sum_{i=0}^n i$.
- Currency stays prose: $5 and $10.
